title: Catalysts & Watchpoints - 18/01/2033
bullet1: Axiom Compute reported Q4 2032 earnings on January 14: revenue beat consensus by 2.1% on strong data-center demand, while gross margin compressed 80bps on component costs.
bullet2: Two sell-side desks raised price targets following the print, citing a stronger-than-expected order backlog into the first half of 2033.
bullet3: A pending antitrust review in one export market adds a monitoring point against the quality score's assumption of unconstrained channel access.
